content: ggplot2 theming: custom theme_*() functions via theme_set() or theme_update(). For fonts in 2025, the recommended stack is ragg (graphics device) + systemfonts (font discovery) + textshaping (shaping). base_family argument in theme_minimal/theme_bw/etc. sets default font. In R Markdown chunks: knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev='ragg_png'). PDF font rendering via ragg still limited. ggthemes 5.2.0 provides theme_economist, theme_wsj, etc. for financial data. Custom themes: create a named function wrapping theme() for package-wide consistency. theme_set() in .onLoad or report template for consistent output.
